topics.parent_demand_anchor: dash cam parking mode / 24/7 parking protection

topics.parent_demand_anchor: 4 channel dash cam / dash cam with side cameras
topics.business_question: When buyers ask for front, rear and side coverage, does the answer set include four-channel cameras, and is the side-channel quality treated as usable evidence?
topics.possible_action: Publish per-channel resolution and simultaneous-recording proof, and clarify which side cameras ship in the box versus as add-ons.

topics.parent_demand_anchor: dash cam night vision / license plate at night
topics.business_question: When buyers ask for night footage good enough to identify a plate, which cameras are recommended, and on what evidence?
topics.possible_action: Publish the sensor and low-light evidence the page currently omits, plus night plate-capture samples; correct or confirm the STARVIS comparison.

attribute_plan.reason: Q01 asks for continuous recording while parked rather than collision-only; it is the buying scenario the four-channel line exists for and the strongest brand-side capability.
Q03 asks for maximum exterior coverage and Q09 shows four-channel demand; this is where the H1 four-camera configuration is a real differentiator rather than parity.
Q04 and Q05 show buyers name the low-light sensor and plate legibility as the deciding standard; the official page publishes no sensor model, so the brand's real position is an evidence gap.
Q07 describes batteries swelling and dying in hot summers and Q06 puts heat tolerance ahead of sale price; the supercapacitor rated -20 to 70 °C is a publishable strength.
Q02 asks what else must be bought, Q10 asks for parking mode without hardwiring and Q11 asks about battery drain; the official page contradicts itself on whether a hardwire kit is required.
Q04 asks for true 4K; the brand's front channel is 3K with 1080P sides, so clarity is a comparison dimension to be framed as usable per-channel evidence, not a resolution race.
Q06 lists SD card support among the checks buyers make before price; relevant to four-channel retention but rarely decides the shortlist on its own.
Q08 shows quality and customer-service doubt despite good review scores and Q12 shows warranty being searched; brand-controlled but policy-shaped, so it affects purchase more than shortlisting.
Q02 and Q04 show budget and total-cost thinking, including accessories; price moves with promotion and the brand's kit pricing, so it is monitored but not a positioning pillar.
Feature-level in the Case; no buyer-language source in the signal pass raises it as a purchase gate.
attribute_plan.no_carrier_reason: No buyer-language evidence in the signal pass; no Topic opened, no Prompt written, and the attribute stays visible for the client to disagree.

attribute_plan.reason: Self-described product feature with no buyer demand in the signal pass.
attribute_plan.no_carrier_reason: Feature with no buyer-language evidence; monitoring it would measure a spec, not a purchase decision.

quality_checks.buyer_reality: A commuter deciding what to buy asks exactly this.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams are worth buying under $200 without a monthly subscription?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q04 states a hard budget; Q08 frames the same purchase at under $200.

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams survive hot summers without the internal battery swelling up?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q07 is almost this sentence in the buyer's own words.

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams include enough storage with the camera so I don't have to buy a card separately?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q06 lists SD card support among the checks made before price.

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q02 asks what else has to be bought and Q10 asks for parking mode without hardwiring.

questions.user_question: Which dash cam brands actually honor their warranty when a camera fails?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q08 doubts quality and service despite good review scores; Q12 shows warranty being searched by model.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams give the best picture for the price for a first-time buyer?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams give the best picture for the price for a first-time buyer?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: A first-time buyer weighs picture quality against price in one question.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams do people recommend for a car that sits in the sun all day in a hot climate?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Heat failure is described by parking situation, which is how owners talk about it.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Tests the same attribute through a parking-exposure condition rather than a battery-failure symptom.

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams keep recording the whole time my car is parked, not just when it gets hit?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q01 is this question in the buyer's own words.

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q11 is the highest-intent parking-mode worry surfaced by the search data.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams include the hardwire kit needed for parking mode in the box?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams include the hardwire kit needed for parking mode in the box?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q02 asks for exactly this before buying.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams capture a hit-and-run while the car is parked on the street overnight?

questions.user_question: Which dash cams can keep parking surveillance running for a full 24 hours?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Duration is the first follow-up an owner asks once parking mode is on the table.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams send an alert to my phone when someone hits the parked car?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Owners parking away from home want to know in the moment, not after reviewing footage.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams are recommended for apartment residents who park in a shared garage?

questions.user_question: Which parking mode setups are worth the total cost once the hardwire kit and memory card are added?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which parking mode setups are worth the total cost once the hardwire kit and memory card are added?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q02 shows the buyer pricing the accessories before committing.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Total-cost framing changes value ranking even when the camera price is unchanged.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams record the front, rear and both sides of the car at the same time?

questions.user_question: Which dash cams give the widest exterior coverage for a large SUV or pickup?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams give the widest exterior coverage for a large SUV or pickup?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: US buyers of large vehicles ask about coverage because a front camera cannot see the sides.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Vehicle size changes which camera angles are enough.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams cover the blind spots on both sides while I am driving?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪能在我行驶时覆盖左右两侧的盲区？
questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams cover the blind spots on both sides while I am driving?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Side blind spots are the concrete version of Q03's maximum exterior coverage.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Moves coverage from parked to driving, where side cameras are judged differently.

questions.user_question: Which multi-channel dash cams keep every camera at usable resolution instead of blurry side footage?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些多路行车记录仪每一路都保持可用清晰度，而不是侧摄像头画面糊掉？

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q04's plate-legibility standard turns into a per-channel quality question once four cameras are involved.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Separates cameras with a strong front channel and weak side channels from genuinely usable four-channel systems.

questions.user_question: Which dash cam setups let me add side cameras later instead of replacing the whole system?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪方案可以以后再补侧摄像头，而不用整套替换？
questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cam setups let me add side cameras later instead of replacing the whole system?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Owners who already own a two-channel setup ask this before spending again.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Expandability changes the candidate set for upgrade buyers, who are not the same as first-time buyers.

questions.user_question: Which multi-channel dash cams support a 512GB card so all four cameras can record for weeks?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which multi-channel dash cams support a 512GB card so all four cameras can record for weeks?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q06 lists card support among the pre-price checks; four channels multiply the need.

questions.user_question: Which four-camera dash cam kits include the side cameras in the box rather than selling them separately?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些四路行车记录仪套装把侧摄像头包含在内，而不是单独卖？
questions.monitoring_prompt: Which four-camera dash cam kits include the side cameras in the box rather than selling them separately?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q02 shows buyers want to know about extra purchases before they commit.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Kit contents decide the real four-channel price and which offers are comparable.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams are recommended for a long minivan where the rear camera sits far from the front?

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams are recommended for a long minivan where the rear camera sits far from the front?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Minivan owners must plan cable runs to a distant rear camera before buying.

questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams capture license plates clearly at night?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q04 states plate capture at night as the purchase requirement.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams handle headlight glare from oncoming traffic without washing out the plate?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪能处理对向车灯眩光，不会把车牌拍到过曝？
questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams handle headlight glare from oncoming traffic without washing out the plate?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Oncoming headlights are the standard reason a night plate shot fails.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Dynamic range is a distinct failure mode from low-light sensitivity.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams record usable footage on unlit residential streets at night?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪在没有路灯的住宅街道夜间也能录到可用画面？

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Suburban owners judge night quality on their own unlit street, not on lit highways.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Removes street lighting as a confound, so it tests sensor sensitivity itself.

questions.user_question: What do owners recommend for night footage that holds up in an insurance claim?
questions.zh_translation: 车主们推荐哪种夜间录像，能在保险理赔时站得住？
questions.monitoring_prompt: What do owners recommend for night footage that holds up in an insurance claim?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: The purchase justification is a claim, so buyers ask by outcome rather than by sensor.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Outcome phrasing catches recommendations that spec-phrased questions miss.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams keep night recording reliable in freezing weather?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪在结冰天气下夜间录像依然可靠？

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q07 shows temperature is a real operating worry; night and cold combine in winter driving.
quality_checks.incremental_value: A meaningful compound: cold-weather power behaviour and low-light capture change the candidate set together.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams have the best night vision for dim parking garages?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪在昏暗的地下车库里夜视效果最好？

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Garage lighting is the low-light case that applies while parked as well as while driving.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Adds the indoor low-light scene; kept experimental because the signal pass does not state this scene directly.

questions.user_question: Which dash cams record clear night footage without paying flagship prices?
questions.zh_translation: 哪些行车记录仪不花旗舰价也能录清楚夜间画面？
questions.monitoring_prompt: Which dash cams record clear night footage without paying flagship prices?

quality_checks.buyer_reality: Q04 pairs a specific night requirement with a hard budget, which is how value buyers ask.
quality_checks.incremental_value: Adds the price ceiling to the night decision, changing which cameras are recommended.
